entities.summary: Pier Luigi de Borgia, 1st Duke of Gandía was the illegitimate son of Cardinal Rodrigo Borgia and a member of the House of Borgia. He was the first duke of Gandía, a duchy in the Kingdom of Valencia that King Ferdinand II of Aragon re-established in 1485 as a favour to his father.
